description: Track Flexport shipments, containers and milestones, read bookings, purchase orders, invoices and customs entries, manage products and contacts, and send shipment documents.

flexport_invoice_status_changed_trigger.description: Runs when an invoice's status changes, such as when it is paid or past due.

output.invoice: The record returned by the service

flexport_new_booking_trigger.description: Runs when a booking request is made in Flexport.

output.booking: The record returned by the service

flexport_new_document_trigger.description: Runs when a document is added to one of your shipments.

output.document: The record returned by the service

flexport_new_invoice_trigger.description: Runs when Flexport issues you a new invoice.

output.invoice: The record returned by the service

flexport_new_milestone_trigger.description: Runs for every milestone event Flexport sends to your webhooks, such as a departure, an arrival, a delay or an invoice payment.

output.event: The record returned by the service

flexport_new_purchase_order_trigger.description: Runs when a purchase order is added to Flexport.

output.purchase_order: The record returned by the service

flexport_new_shipment_trigger.description: Runs when a new shipment appears in Flexport.

output.shipment: The record returned by the service

flexport_purchase_order_changed_trigger.description: Runs when a purchase order is added or changed in Flexport.

output.purchase_order: The record returned by the service

flexport_shipment_arrived_trigger.description: Runs when a shipment reaches a port or other stop on its route. Needs a webhook endpoint set up in Flexport.

output.event: The record returned by the service

flexport_shipment_delivered_trigger.description: Runs when a whole shipment has been delivered to its final destination. Needs a webhook endpoint set up in Flexport.

output.event: The record returned by the service

flexport_shipment_departed_trigger.description: Runs when a shipment leaves a port or other stop on its route. Needs a webhook endpoint set up in Flexport.

output.event: The record returned by the service

flexport_shipment_status_changed_trigger.description: Runs when a shipment moves to a new stage, such as arriving at the port.

output.shipment: The record returned by the service
